narrative: Today's technology briefing highlights a significant push in AI, with Google and OpenAI introducing advanced agentic capabilities that streamline business operations and improve security. Concurrently, space exploration continues to yield groundbreaking discoveries, while a wave of core technology and infrastructure updates enhances developer environments and cloud services.

highlights.title: Microsoft 365 Family subscribers will finally be able to share AI benefits
highlights.whyItMatters: Microsoft is extending AI-powered Office features to all family plan members, enhancing collaboration.

highlights.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
highlights.whyItMatters: Google is transforming Gemini into an AI agent capable of planning and executing tasks across business applications.

highlights.title: Webb Measures Distance to Farthest Fast Radio Burst, Suggesting Origin
highlights.whyItMatters: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope has identified the host galaxy of the most distant fast radio burst, shedding light on their mysterious origins.

highlights.title: Apple will reportedly debut its first touchscreen MacBook in three weeks
highlights.whyItMatters: Apple is rumored to be introducing a touchscreen MacBook Pro and an updated iPad Mini, potentially expanding its product lines.

highlights.title: OTel-Native by Design – Building Products That Export to Any Observability Stack
highlights.whyItMatters: The OpenTelemetry initiative is promoting native integration for observability, allowing products to export data to any stack.

highlights.title: Amazon builds 1,000th satellite, will launch space internet service by end of year
highlights.whyItMatters: Amazon is nearing the launch of its space internet service after building its 1,000th satellite, intensifying the satellite internet race.

highlights.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
highlights.whyItMatters: OpenAI is evolving advertising in ChatGPT with new visual formats and enhanced measurement tools for advertisers.

highlights.title: Microsoft’s new Windows Search is exactly what Windows 11 needs
highlights.whyItMatters: Microsoft is overhauling Windows Search in Windows 11 to be faster, more capable, and modern, addressing user frustrations.
